scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: npm --prefix backend run dev & npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.start: npm --prefix backend start & npm --prefix frontend start
scripts.check:backend: node --check backend/server.js && node --check backend/app.js && for f in backend/controllers/*.js backend/routes/*.js backend/models/*.js backend/middleware/*.js backend/config/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
